text: Would you rather know the date of your death or the cause of your death?
Would you rather be able to talk to animals or speak every human language fluently?
Would you rather relive the best day of your life once more, or get to skip the worst day you'll ever have?
Would you rather have unlimited money but no close friends, or great friends but always just scrape by?
Would you rather forget everyone you've ever met, or have everyone you've ever met forget you?
Would you rather always say exactly what you think, or never be able to speak your mind again?
Would you rather be famous for something embarrassing, or completely unknown for something great?
Would you rather be able to pause time or rewind it by ten seconds?
Would you rather live 200 years in the past or 200 years in the future?
Would you rather explore deep space or the deep ocean?
Would you rather have a job you love that pays poorly, or a job you hate that makes you rich?
You find a wallet with €500 and an ID. The owner lives across the country and returning it would cost you a full day. What do you do?
Your best friend's partner is cheating on them, and only you know. Do you tell your friend?
A button gives you €1 million, but a random stranger somewhere loses €10,000. Do you press it?
A runaway trolley will hit five people. You can pull a lever to divert it onto a track with one person. Do you pull it?
If you could have dinner with any person, alive or dead, who would it be and what would you ask first?
If you woke up tomorrow having mastered one new skill, what would you want it to be?
If you had to live in one fictional universe for the rest of your life, which would you pick?
If you could instantly change one law in your country, what would it be?
You get a free year with every expense covered, but you're not allowed to work. What do you do with it?
If animals could talk, which species would be the rudest?
If you could learn the absolute truth to one question, what would you ask?
If your life had a soundtrack, what song would play every time you walk into a room?
If you could swap lives with someone in this room for a week, who would it be and why?
If you could make everyone in the world adopt one habit, what would it be?
Is it ever okay to lie to protect someone's feelings?
If every part of a ship is replaced one by one, is it still the same ship? And what about you?
Would you plug into a machine that gives you a perfectly happy life, if you'd never know it wasn't real?
Does a person's intent matter more than the outcome of what they do?
Can anyone be truly selfless, or is every kind act a little bit selfish?
Should we judge historical figures by today's moral standards?
Is free will real, or are we just very complicated dominoes?
What's a belief you held strongly five years ago that you've completely changed your mind about?
What's the best piece of advice you've ever ignored?
What's a small thing that instantly makes your day better?
What's a skill everyone should learn before turning 30?
What would your 10-year-old self think of you today?
What's something you're proud of that nobody ever asks you about?
